title: Unprepared
html_source: Not just unprepared in the sense of not seeing it coming, but unprepared in the Catholic sense of not having had the opportunity to confess sins, thus dying unshriven.

anchor.prefix: obacconist against which newsboards leaned and told of a dreadful catastrophe in New York. In America those things were continually happening. Unfortunate people to die like that,
